title: wp11_ccid.h: document SW1/SW2 presence in response buffer
description:
wp11_ccid_apdu() documentation in wolfp11/wp11_ccid.h does not state whether the two-byte ISO 7816 status word (SW1/SW2) is included in the response buffer written to *resplen. Every PIV and OpenPGP protocol consumer assumes it is there and reads resp[*resplen-2] and resp[*resplen-1] as SW1/SW2. If a future implementor misreads the API contract and strips or excludes the status bytes, all protocol parsing breaks silently.

Add to the function docstring: 'On success, resp[0..*resplen-3] contains the response data and resp[*resplen-2...*resplen-1] contains the ISO 7816 SW1/SW2 status bytes. *resplen is always >= 2 on success.'
